clips.title: The story
paras: This quest marks a rite of passage for young adventurers on Zephras Isle, directing them to report to one of the island's leading authorities. After completing early trials under Rorian the Dayseeker, promising youths are sent into Thendal Grove to meet Aetheen of the Gales, an elder who reads the winds and evaluates the next generation.

The early tasks set before novitiates on Zephras Isle are not merely mundane chores; they serve as informal tests to evaluate whether rising youths possess the grit and spirit needed to defend their homeland. Recognizing that island life faces growing trials, mentors such as Rorian the Dayseeker keep a watchful eye on candidates who prove capable of handling greater responsibility.

Deep within Thendal Grove sits Aetheen of the Gales, a respected member of the Council of Elders governing Zephras Isle. Aetheen spends her time reading the currents of the air and assessing young shen'dorei as they come of age. Stepping before her signifies that an initiate has outgrown minor perimeter duties and is ready to tackle direct threats facing the community.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: You may not realize this but everything you've done has been a trial of sorts. A test for what is to come for you. It's a big island out there, and Zephras needs spirited young adventurers such as yourself if we are to survive the trials our people face.
The one called Aetheen of the Gales is one of the leaders of our people here on Zephras Isle, and she has been watching you. She has a task that you must complete. Speak with her to learn more.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Rorian has told me much of you. I am likely unknown to you, but I am a member of the Council of Elders here on Zephras Isle. I've come to read the flow of the winds here in Thendal Grove. I'm also here to assess young shen'dorei such as yourself that are coming of age.
So tell me, are you ready to take your next step? Are you ready to serve Zephras Isle?

sources.title: Quest text as quoted on the Warcraft Wiki
